$comment: 2026-10-13 canonical-identifier policy for symbols that may reach an IBKR STK (equity) request. Reviewed config, not a UI knob. Oct 13 audit: 82 IBKR code-200 historical rejections in 2h came from NULL, NONE, DIAGTEST<ts>, DIAGPIPE<ts>, USDJPY (FX), SPX (index) and company-name strings - none of them equities, all of them passing a pure ticker-regex. This list REJECTS identifiers that are provably not routable equities (placeholders, test-only diagnostics, FX pairs, cash indices); it is not a blacklist of 'bad tickers' - anything else that merely is not a security is caught by IBKR's own reqContractDetails answer (cached as NOT_FOUND).
